q: What limit applies to departmental appeals before the Appellate Tribunal under Circular 3/2018?
ctx: [doc=Circular_3_2018.pdf page=2] ... appeals/ SLPs shall not be filed in cases where the tax effect does not exceed the monetary limits given hereunder: S. No. Appeals/ SLPs in Income-tax Monetary Limit (Rs.) matters 1. Before Appellate Tribunal 20,00,000 2. Before High Court 50,00,000

a.answer: Circular 3/2018 (issued under the 1961 Act) bars departmental appeals before the Appellate Tribunal where the tax effect does not exceed Rs. 20,00,000. Note it was later amended by Circular 17/2019 if that is in context.
